title: How to Calculate DSCR on a Rental, and What Ratio a Lender Actually Wants
description: DSCR is rent divided by PITIA, but the details decide your deal. How lenders calculate it, what ratio you need, and how to fix a deal that comes in under.

title: What Is a Hard Money Loan?

description: Leverage and speed turn one deal a year into several. The math behind doing more with the same cash.

description: Two loans, one repeatable engine: buy and rehab with hard money, refinance with DSCR, recycle your capital.
